cases.prompt: We have three LLM features going live next quarter. Here are the request volumes and average tokens; what will this cost per month on the models we picked, and where can we save?
expected: Asks for a dated price sheet if none is given; never quotes a vendor price from memory
Runs scripts/cost_model.py; reports total, by feature, cost per request and caching saving
What-if only across models the user marked eligible, with the quality caveat

cases.prompt: Should we self-host an open model on our own GPUs instead of paying per token?
expected: Routes GPU capacity and self-host vs rent to infra-gpu-sizing; offers this skill for the API side of the comparison

expected: Total 855.00; support-chat 465.00 with caching saving 135.00; what-if fict-small 38.75; utilisation 85.5%

expected: Asks for the price sheet; never fills typical prices

expected: Total 855.00 exceeds 800: OVER BUDGET, all three alert levels reached, run exits 1; outputs still written
